details: For every $k\ge1$, a VC-shattered set gives a regular shattered tree, which satisfies the prefix-$k$ constraints.
proof_source: Full proof in the LaTeX survey: Proposition `prop:prefix-littlestone-order`.
witness_verification: For each fixed k>1, use construction width b=k and let height n grow in the branching batch-tree class. Its exact values are PL_k=kn and VC=k. The normalized ratio kn/(1+k) tends to infinity; this is not merely a finite or k-varying gap. See survey Corollary prop:branching-batch-separations and the database-owned value proofs.
name: Prefix-$k$ Littlestone Dimension / VC Dimension
